video_title: Breaking down Jalen Duren's preseason debut with the Pistons 🏀😤 | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren needs to be highlighted in isolation to develop
quotes.excerpt: I want to see JB Bickerstaff highlight this young man in isolation
quotes.quote: My brother, the great Kevin Garnett, told me a lot, said a lot. But the one thing he always said was, always watch young players to see how they are going to perform after they get their bread. Jalen Duren got his lettuce. And $200 million is, we are going to play through you type lettuce. I don't want to just see drop-offs. I don't want to see pick-and-rolls. I want to see JB Bickerstaff highlight this young man in isolation because last year in the postseason, Tobias Harris was their second option. He is not there no more. So, who is going to take that pressure off of Cade? Meaning a guy that you can actually run a play for and for him to go get a bucket. It is time for Jalen Duren. JB has to use this regular season to highlight that even more so that when they get to postseason, it is not foreign to them.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren's playmaking ability when Cade Cunningham was injured
quotes.excerpt: When Cade had that lung injury last year, Jalen Duren became a bit of a creator
quotes.quote: Jalen Duren looked like a $200 million player in this game. I really liked how they put the ball in his hand. We saw in some of those highlights that he was having the ball and creating. When Cade had that lung injury last year, Jalen Duren became a bit of a creator and a ball-handler because they were squeezed for that. I loved that part of his game and they went away from that totally when Cade came back. I think it is smart of JB Bickerstaff right out of the gate to reintroduce part of that package with Duren. He can do a lot more than just finish lobs. He has got a lot of talent, he is a super athlete, and you know he is going to do it on the defensive end.

quotes.speaker: Zach Lowe
quotes.summary_phrase: Pistons and Knicks have an advantage hitting the ground running
quotes.excerpt: I think them and New York have an advantage when we get the start of this year
quotes.quote: I think they are going to win a lot of regular season games. I agree with Cade Cunningham that they are slept on. They won 60 games last year and they have 11 players returning. They lost Tobias Harris and Isaiah Stewart, replaced with John Collins and Isaiah Joe. I think them and New York have an advantage when we get the start of this year as far as hitting the ground running. When you look at LeBron integrating in Philly, Kawhi in Toronto, even Indiana, some of these teams that have just been put together this summer here. But I at the end of the day, they are going to be judged in the playoffs. As many games they win in the regular season, what they do in the postseason is going to be the thing.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Cooper Flagg's impressive leadership and development in preseason
quotes.excerpt: My takeaway was just how impressive Cooper Flagg is going into his second season
quotes.quote: First off, I have to say that Kyrie, first game in 19 months, he looked very good. He was totally himself moving with and without the ball very well. But my takeaway was just how impressive Cooper Flagg is going into his second season. One of the things that really stood out to me sitting courtside those games was listening to Cooper Flagg's voice. He was not just talking about what he was doing, he was talking and directing his teammates. That to me shows growth and understanding and comfort level. You can tell he has been working on his footwork, you can tell he has been working on his shot. The guy is going to score. The guy is going to defend two or three positions at the other end. But I really could feel his leadership watching him play.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Kristaps Porzingis's health and frontcourt depth concerns
quotes.excerpt: The big question is that how long is this going to linger here

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Oh man, they need him. I think the one of the big questions was their frontcourt depth here and now when you are looking at Al Horford and Draymond Green and certainly Axel Lendenberg here, I think it is the big question is that how long is this going to linger here. He is on a $20 million technically expiring contract and if they need to make a move down the road, he could be the odd man out here.

text_blocks.speaker: Zach Lowe
text_blocks.text: Well and that is one of the reasons why that is the contract that he is on.
